health.DESCRIPTION: Whether each device is alive. Not a device: a device whose file lists "health" in its HOST_INFO's CLOCKWORK_CHAOS_IMPLEMENTS sends uptime_s with {device} as its own name. Memory synthesises the rest from the arrivals of uptime_s.

uptime_s.DESCRIPTION: Time since the device booted, where it can tell; else since its program started. Its heartbeat: a drop is a reboot, or on a device that cannot tell its boot, a restart.

last_seen.DESCRIPTION: When Memory last received uptime_s from the device, as RFC 3339 UTC. Sent by Memory, not the device.

state.DESCRIPTION: connected while uptime_s keeps arriving, lost once it has stopped for longer than Memory's timeout. Sent by Memory, not the device.
